title: Egyptian Fennel Stir-Fry
description: A simple and flavorful stir-fry recipe from Egypt, featuring fennel as the main ingredient. This dish is perfect for a quick and easy dinner.
instructions: 1. Slice the fennel into thin wedges.
2. Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
3. Add 2 tablespoons of oil to the skillet and swirl to coat.
4. Add the sliced fennel to the skillet and cook for 5 minutes.
5. Add 1 cup of aerated water to the skillet and bring to a boil.
6. Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 10 minutes.
7. Serve the fennel hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
